verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
verses.english: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? That is:

verses.pali: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
verses.english: the cosmos is eternal, or not eternal …

verses.pali: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
verses.english: after death, a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists.”

verses.pali: “Vedanāya kho, vaccha, aññāṇā, vedanāsamudaye aññāṇā, vedanānirodhe aññāṇā, vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā;
verses.english: “Vaccha, it is because of not knowing feeling, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation
that these various misconceptions arise in the world.

verses.pali: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vāti.
Ayaṁ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason.”

verses.pali: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti.
